facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this part of Phu Quoc. Sunset Town pulls you in with colonial-style architecture, neon-lit streets at dusk, and a waterfront that looks nothing like the beach resorts. 4.6 stars across 4,731 reviews and it still catches people off guard. Go at golden hour. Stay for the lights. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
